script_text: Aquarius, the stars are flashing a warning where you expected a yes. The Sun at 4° Libra activates your 7th House, squaring Uranus, your air-sign ruler, at 1° Gemini in your 3rd House. That clash exposes inflated promises and assumptions. An unexpected connection is likelier through a neighborhood event, online message, or unusual shared interest than a polished dating app. If partnered, watch for sudden plans or one person abruptly changing the emotional temperature. Mars in Taurus activates your 2nd House, favoring a raise request, freelance bid, or careful budget reset, but avoid impulsive spending today. The 10th House rewards a concise proposal that clearly explains your value in numbers before you send it. Unexpected gift: your sharpest idea arrives when you nearly abandon the project. Follow for tomorrow’s reading and catch the next shift before it steals your advantage.
